purpose: Govern Stage 12B treatment of TASS as a professional news-agency source without assuming that the public website or customer delivery products are open factual-ingestion routes.

sources.available_at_policy: Do not create factual NewsSourceRecord evidence from TASS until an approved or licensed delivery route exposes a stable source identifier/reference and provable timezone-aware publication timestamp. Do not substitute public-page crawl time, HTTP Date, or ingestion time for publication time.

evidence.provider_business_delivery: TASS publicly describes its professional news feeds as information products delivered to customers through terminal, FTP, API, RSS and e-mail.
evidence.public_site_status: Public tass.ru pages are readable, but public readability does not by itself establish automated storage, redistribution, or feed-ingestion rights for Stage 12B.

unblock_conditions: approved or licensed TASS delivery route is available to the project
route access terms permit the intended automated ingestion and persistence
bounded acquisition and final-host validation are implemented
timezone-aware publication timestamp semantics are proven
source failure remains isolated from the rest of the official_news batch
